semantic_review: HOME resolution and RUNNING_UNLOCKED are checked by FallbackHome before finish() is requested. Resolver readiness therefore does not synchronously prove completed native Activity removal. Reference markers only authorize a bounded read-only wait; the unchanged all-Activity no-body parser is still required before original capture. This is a source-qualified readiness gap, not proof that FallbackHome caused original41687321949.
